meta.title: ConvertCCY instrument classification and treatment policy
meta.authority: This file is the single authoritative source for instrument classification and treatment policy. data/currencies.json remains the identity layer (names, symbols, numeric codes); its legacy instrument_type field is a compatibility label reconciled against this file by scripts/validate_instrument_classification.py.
meta.fact_policy: Facts marked verification_status=requires_source_verification, and every code with classification_confidence below 'high', must be source-verified before they are published on any public page. Classification here is internal governance metadata; nothing in this file is rendered to users in A4.1.
meta.historical_reference_policy: historical_reference holds the ONLY historical/legacy facts that may be rendered publicly (SEO-A4.2). Every claim and fixed conversion cites verification_sources entries by key, index and the exact 'supports' string; status and successor come from the instrument record. Dates and numbers are never rendered unless cited here.

fiat_currency.definition: Circulating legal-tender currency issued by a national monetary authority or a currency-union authority.

restricted_fiat_currency.definition: Legal-tender fiat currency that is officially non-convertible or has no accessible international market quotation; any rate shown must state which regime (official vs market) it represents.

precious_metal.definition: ISO 4217 precious-metal code quoted per troy ounce; a commodity price, not a currency issued by an authority.

unit_of_account.definition: Non-circulating accounting or indexation unit defined by a national authority (e.g. inflation- or wage-indexed units).

regional_unit.definition: Non-circulating unit of account defined by a regional or multilateral body for settlement or institutional accounting.

special_instrument.definition: Supranational reserve asset that also serves as a unit of account (the IMF Special Drawing Right); not a circulating currency.

historical_currency.definition: Currency withdrawn from legal tender and replaced by a successor; only archival or fixed-conversion context is meaningful.

legacy_transition.definition: Code still listed or de jure legal tender but superseded in practice (redenomination or dollarization); fixed parity to a successor where official.

test_code.definition: ISO 4217 code reserved for testing; never a currency and never has an exchange rate.

no_currency.definition: ISO 4217 code denoting transactions where no currency is involved; never has an exchange rate.

ANG.issuer_name: Centrale Bank van Curaçao en Sint Maarten
ANG.reclassification_reason: Legacy label fiat_currency: replaced by the Caribbean guilder (XCG) in Curaçao and Sint Maarten in 2025.
ANG.notes: XCG became legal tender on 2025-03-31; ANG and XCG were exchanged 1:1. ANG cash use ended after 2025-06-30. The current provider still quotes ANG despite its historical status; XCG is not yet in the site set.

BGN.reclassification_reason: Legacy label fiat_currency: Bulgaria adopted the euro on 2026-01-01; the lev is no longer legal tender after the dual-circulation period.
BGN.notes: Bulgaria adopted the euro on 2026-01-01 at EUR 1 = BGN 1.95583. The provider quote is therefore successor-derived rather than a current independent BGN market rate.

CLF.notes: Unidad de Fomento: an inflation-indexed unit calculated by Banco Central de Chile under its official methodology. Provider values remain secondary to the issuer valuation.

CUC.reclassification_reason: Legacy label legacy_or_transition: withdrawn under the 2021 Cuban monetary unification; historical rather than in transition.
CUC.notes: Cuba began monetary unification on 2021-01-01; CUC was withdrawn over the statutory 180-day period and CUP became the sole national legal tender. Official conversion used CUC 1 = CUP 24.

CUP.reclassification_reason: Legacy label fiat_currency: not internationally convertible; official and informal rates are reported to diverge widely.
CUP.notes: CUP is Cuba's sole national legal tender after the 2021 monetary unification. The 24 CUP/USD rate is verified as the unification-era official rate, but the current applicable exchange regime and divergence from other official/market channels still require A4.6 review.

EUR.reclassification_reason: Legacy label regional_currency: a circulating fiat currency; multi-country scope is captured by jurisdiction_scope.

HRK.reclassification_reason: Legacy label legacy_or_transition: the kuna is withdrawn (euro changeover 2023), so it is historical rather than in transition.
HRK.notes: Replaced by the euro on 2023-01-01. The provider quote equals the fixed euro conversion applied to the current EUR rate, so pages currently present a market-style rate for a withdrawn currency.

IRR.notes: Remains classified as ordinary fiat; multiple or managed exchange-rate regimes are reported for this currency. A4.6 must verify which regime the provider quote represents before any reclassification.

KPW.reclassification_reason: Legacy label fiat_currency: officially non-convertible with no accessible international market quotation.
KPW.notes: KPW is verified as the national currency of the DPRK. The current generic FX snapshot omits it; any future displayed value must be attributed to a clearly identified official/institutional rate rather than presented as an unrestricted market quotation.

LBP.notes: Banque du Liban publishes an official USD/LBP series at 89,500 in 2026; the ConvertCCY 2026-11-18 snapshot also carries 89,500. Classification and current reference-rate provenance are therefore issuer-anchored.

MMK.notes: Remains classified as ordinary fiat; multiple or managed exchange-rate regimes are reported for this currency. A4.6 must verify which regime the provider quote represents before any reclassification.

SLL.notes: Redenominated in 2022 (1 SLE = 1,000 SLL). The provider quote equals 1,000 x the SLE rate. Exact end of legal-tender status requires verification.

SVC.issuer_name: Banco Central de Reserva de El Salvador
SVC.notes: El Salvador dollarized in 2001 at a fixed 8.75 colones per US dollar; the colón remains de jure legal tender but does not circulate.

SYP.notes: Remains classified as ordinary fiat; multiple or managed exchange-rate regimes are reported for this currency. A4.6 must verify which regime the provider quote represents before any reclassification.

TMT.notes: Remains classified as ordinary fiat; multiple or managed exchange-rate regimes are reported for this currency. A4.6 must verify which regime the provider quote represents before any reclassification.

UYW.notes: Unidad Previsional is an official Uruguayan indexed unit published by Banco Central del Uruguay. Its value is institutionally published rather than market-traded.

VED.notes: ISO 4217 lists both VES (928) and VED (926, introduced for the 2021 redenomination). Providers quote the circulating bolívar under VES; the VES/VED mapping and the official (BCV) vs market regime need source verification.

VES.notes: ISO 4217 lists both VES (928) and VED (926, introduced for the 2021 redenomination). Providers quote the circulating bolívar under VES; the VES/VED mapping and the official (BCV) vs market regime need source verification.

XAF.reclassification_reason: Legacy label regional_currency: a circulating fiat currency; multi-country scope is captured by jurisdiction_scope.

XAG.notes: Quoted per troy ounce. The current FX provider does not price metals; a dedicated metals benchmark source is required.

XAU.notes: Quoted per troy ounce. The current FX provider does not price metals; a dedicated metals benchmark source is required.

XCD.reclassification_reason: Legacy label regional_currency: a circulating fiat currency; multi-country scope is captured by jurisdiction_scope.

XDR.reclassification_reason: Legacy label unit_of_account: the SDR is an IMF reserve asset as well as a unit of account; classified as a supranational instrument.
XDR.notes: IMF Special Drawing Right. The IMF calculates its currency value from a basket of major currencies and publishes the valuation daily on IMF business days. Provider values remain secondary to the issuer valuation.

XOF.issuer_name: Central Bank of West African States (BCEAO)
XOF.reclassification_reason: Legacy label regional_currency: a circulating fiat currency; multi-country scope is captured by jurisdiction_scope.

XPD.notes: Quoted per troy ounce. The current FX provider does not price metals; a dedicated metals benchmark source is required.

XPF.reclassification_reason: Legacy label regional_currency: a circulating fiat currency used across several French Pacific territories by one issuer.

XPT.notes: Quoted per troy ounce. The current FX provider does not price metals; a dedicated metals benchmark source is required.

XSU.reclassification_reason: Legacy label unit_of_account: defined by a regional body (SUCRE system), so classified as a regional unit.
XSU.notes: SUCRE regional compensation unit (ALBA-TCP members). Current operational status and publishing body require verification.

XTS.notes: Reserved by ISO 4217 for testing. Pair pages are candidates for consolidation into one standards reference page.

XUA.reclassification_reason: Legacy label unit_of_account: defined by a multilateral regional institution (African Development Bank), so classified as a regional unit.
XUA.notes: African Development Bank Unit of Account. AfDB states that one UA is equivalent to one IMF Special Drawing Right (SDR); issuer methodology is the governing valuation basis.

XXX.notes: ISO 4217 code for transactions where no currency is involved. Pair pages are candidates for consolidation into one ISO semantics reference page.

ZWL.reclassification_reason: Legacy label legacy_or_transition: replaced by ZiG (ZWG) in 2024; historical rather than in transition.
ZWL.notes: Zimbabwe dollar balances were converted to ZiG in April 2024; ZW$ notes ceased legal-tender use after 2024-04-30. ISO code ZWG/924 formally replaced ZWL/932 effective 2024-06-25. The provider still aliases ZWL to the ZWG value; ZWG is not yet in the site set.
